title: Easy Homemade Chicken Pot Pie
description: This deliciously easy homemade chicken pot pie is a family favorite made with chicken breasts, canned green beans and condensed soup.
ingredients: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cubed
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C.)

Combine flour and onion salt in a large mixing bowl; cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add water and stir until it forms a ball. Divide dough in half and shape into balls. Roll one ball out to fit a 9 or 10-inch pie plate. Place bottom crust in pie plate and roll out top crust.

Heat 1 tablespoon shortening in a large cast iron frying pan. Add chicken and onion and cook until mixture is just browned. Stir in green beans and season with onion salt, sugar, garlic powder, pepper, and oregano. Stir in condensed soup. Heat mixture, stirring constantly, until it just begins to simmer. Pour into pie crust and cover with top crust. Fold top crust under edge of bottom crust, seal and cut slits in top crust.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
